alphabets: Zero-based Hebrew אבגדהוזחטיכלמנסעפצקרשת with final forms folded; Greek αβγδεζηθικλμνξοπρστυφχψω under the common normalization. Modulo24 remains unchanged in binary calibration.
catalog: Nested order direction,a-index,b-index,c; rule_id=(((direction_index*4+a_index)*4+b_index)*24+c). These IDs belong to FAM-006 and do not identify the former FAM-004 formulas.
counts: Report oriented source starts, indexed base/start entries, Greek starts, four b-specific Greek seed queries per start, compatible base/source/Greek seed pairs, and formal rule/start pairs=indexed_starts*Greek_starts*24; none is an independent-sample count.
description_code: Conditional parameter payload:1 direction bit+2 a-index bits+2 b-index bits+5 c bits=10, rejecting c24..31. Elias-gamma family tag6 is00110 (5 bits), then five length bits and six passage addresses. Include decoder, family/corpus/normalization definitions and all file sizes/hashes. This explicit code is not a universal shortest-description or divine-origin probability claim.
formula: g[-1]=0; g[i]=(a*h[i]+b*g[i-1]+c) mod24, with a single complete rule for three passage pairs.
independent_algorithm: Transform each candidate Greek window to d[0]=g[0], d[i]=g[i]-b*g[i-1]. Independently enumerate every full parameter code and compare d[i] to a*h[i]+c, using absolute seed values, separate catalog parsing and inclusion-exclusion of group edges. Do not reuse the primary weighted signature or recurrence propagation for scoring.
limitations: Window resets are computational conventions, not historical boundaries. The grammar is finite and may share outputs with prior families; those overlaps and all seven prior exposed target evaluations remain counted. No new reserved data, chronological letter certification or independent scientific replication.
reference_models: Within-unit labelled word permutation and global same-length word-type bijection; repeat whole-family, position, length and triple selection. Inclusive p=(1+exceedances)/(B+1). No finite-family correction is claimed for indefinitely adaptive family selection.
resource_failure: Stop with an incomplete archived attempt; no truncation or favorable subset. Resource changes require an explicit prospective amendment.
search: Index every source-window start for all32 bases with z[-1]=S[-1]=0, z[i]=a*h[i]+b*z[i-1], S[i]=1+b*S[i-1]; signature at i1..7 is z[i]-S[i]*z[0] mod24. For each Greek unit/start and b in coefficient order, query g[i]-S[i]*g[0]; a hit fixes c=g[0]-z[0]. Verify and extend the actual recurrence, never refit c. Keep the first longest edge per source/destination group pair and use deterministic ascending-group augmenting paths. Prefix monotonicity makes this edge compression valid.
semantics: Reset the state to exactly zero at each candidate source-window start, not once at the beginning of the unit. No free state parameter. K output letters consume K contiguous source letters, oriented as a whole before recurrence. Extending an oriented window preserves its predicted prefix. No gaps, source wrapping, Greek reversal, approximate matches or adaptive constants.
source_scope: A future source scan can use every simple physical island with>=8 letters, no agreement/diversity/date filtering. This length consequence alone does not authorize a target scan. Calibration uses the declared human input.
stage: Definition and calibration only; separate human-control, variant-transfer and target protocols required.
statistic: Maximum K8..32 for one fixed (direction,a,b,c) on three distinct source groups and three distinct Greek groups; zero if absent and32 censored. Keep all768 observed scores, all positive maximizing parameter IDs and deterministic literal witnesses, including every tie and repeated output.
